description:
Welcome to 69 Zodiac Drive, Alkimos! A Stunning lock up and leave, three-bedroom home within walking distance to the beach.

From the dreamy location to the low maintenance yet high-quality finishes, this home is sure to catch your eye.

The kitchen features quality stainless-steel appliances, including a gas stove top, oven, rangehood, double sink, dishwasher, large pantry, stone benches, a breakfast bar and additional power points.

The kitchen overlooks the open plan family/dining /activity area which is equipped with a large split system air conditioner. This area is large, bright and breezy with sliding glass doors that lead out to the courtyard perfect for year-round entertaining.

The Master bedroom is large, split system air conditioning, with a great sized walk-in robe and ensuite. The ensuite bathroom features stylish tap wear and quality finishings. A further two good sized bedrooms, both with plush carpets, built in robes, and quality window treatments

Outside:
The Front yard is neatly retained and easy care. The rear of this property is low maintenance with a side grass area and paving plus a trendy garden bed.

Additional features include:
Split system air conditioning to master bedroom and living areas
LED lighting throughout
Rear laneway access to double garage with remote door and drive through access.

Location Highlights:
It is within the intake area of Shorehaven Primary School and Alkimos College.
Close to ample shopping, Parks and walking distance to Oceans 27 restaurant.

Don't miss the opportunity to secure this fantastic home in a highly sought-after location. Register your interest today and experience everything this property has to offer.
